summary.zh: 迁移说明修正：切换项目文件语言后，check 与 update --only content 不提示模板变化，改为说明用 fix update-content 或 init_project.py --mode refresh 预览，并写清两者对改过文件的处理差异。
summary.en: Fix the migration notes: after switching the project file language, check and update --only content do not report template changes; point to fix update-content or init_project.py --mode refresh for the preview and explain how they treat edited files differently.
